question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=-2 \\ -6{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}+9{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}\,\,[\begin{aligned}40 & -20 & -60 \\ -20 & 10 & a \\ c & 30 & 90\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ b \\ 15\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the system of linear equations and its corresponding normal equation shown above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we write our system in matrix form as $Ax=b,$ where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & -3 \\ -6 & 3 & 9\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

The normal equation corresponding to $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{T}\,Ax & ={A}^{T}b \\ [\begin{aligned}2 & -6 \\ -1 & 3 \\ -3 & 9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & -3 \\ -6 & 3 & 9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -6 \\ -1 & 3 \\ -3 & 9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}40 & 20 & -60 \\ -20 & 10 & 30 \\ -60 & 30 & 90\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ 5 \\ 15\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=30+5+(-60)=-25.
$$
